This is Tom, in London. He maintains the government's emergency status board. At ten, the internet went down.
By noon, France had mobilised. The status board changed to 'ALL CLEAR: DRAFT'.
At one, the sirens. Londoners queued beneath a sign asking them to queue calmly.
At ten past two, France detonated a nuclear weapon over the Celtic Sea, as a warning.
Underground, an emergency meeting was scheduled to schedule the emergency meeting. The table location was still pending.
On day two, a ceasefire. Both sides agreed on peace, then moved the meeting table again.
On day three, Tom came home. The status board now says 'NORMAL: DEFINITION PENDING'.
